title: Texas Senate nominee James Talarico reappears after multi-day absence - The Washington Post
description: The Democrat’s campaign said he was recovering from the flu, while Republicans tried to make his absence seem suspicious.

title: Three men found guilty in the 2024 killing of Australian and US surfers in Mexico - CNN
description: A local judge on Friday found three Mexicans guilty of the murders of two Australian brothers and their American friend in April 2024 in the Mexican state of Baja California.

title: UAW leader reviled by Trump declares victory in reelection - The Washington Post
description: United Auto Workers President Shawn Fain said Friday that he had easily beat his top challenger.

title: Dream sweep Liberty to earn first WNBA Finals berth since 2013 - ESPN
description: The Dream finished the Liberty with an 85-83 win in Game 3 to advance to the WNBA Finals for the first time since 2013.

title: Newport Beach declares local emergency after coastal flooding on Balboa Peninsula - CBS News
description: Aerial footage over the Balboa Peninsula showed people wading barefoot on sidewalks and streets, some knee-deep in rainboots and vehicles nearly half-submerged.
